title: The burden of dyslipidaemia and factors associated with lipid levels among adults in rural northern Ghana: An AWI-Gen sub-study

correction.scope: Corrects hip/waist circumference values in Table 1 and reference 14; no lipid/BMI/age correction stated. Those hip/waist values are not extracted here.
